blocks.rationale: Jointly revise the actual exception producer and terminal consumer to consume the measured literal-clause bundle. The producer now derives representative coverage and attached safeguards from source text, avoiding unresolved synthesized fields. The consumer distinguishes an express representative permission, a broad third-party prohibition, and an employee query not addressed by the volunteer agreement. This improves the trigger's nda-5 result while preserving its nda-7 result and the historical disclosure classifications; nda-16 and nda-20 remain on ordinary fallback.

skill.intent: Determine from literal current-agreement clauses whether a disclosure-permission query names a recipient class covered by an express Representatives permission with its confidentiality, need-to-know, and purpose limitations.

inputs.name: current_question
inputs.question: What is the caller-supplied disclosure-permission question whose stated recipient category must be tested against the current agreement's literal disclosure clauses?

outputs.name: exception_applies
outputs.description: Whether the query names at least one recipient category expressly permitted by the current agreement subject to stated confidentiality, need-to-know, and purpose restrictions.

premises.name: nondisclosure_clauses
premises.question: Which literal current-source spans state the nondisclosure obligations and any express disclosure permissions or exceptions, including attached qualifications?

premises.name: party_and_recipient_definitions
premises.question: Which literal current-source spans define the parties, obligated roles, or recipient groups used by the nondisclosure clauses?

reads.question: Locate the source text governing confidentiality/nondisclosure, its express disclosure permissions or exceptions, and the definitions needed to interpret those clauses. Select source spans only; do not decide any native hypothesis.
reads.source_locator: Complete supplied current source, including operative clauses, attached qualifications and definitions.

fields.name: nondisclosure_clauses
fields.question: Select the literal nondisclosure obligations and any expressly stated disclosure permissions/exceptions, preserving their attached qualifications and references. Select a governing clause even when it does not name Representatives. Do not select unrelated protected-information lists or notification duties as permissions.

fields.name: party_and_recipient_definitions
fields.question: Select literal source definitions identifying the parties/roles and recipient groups used by the nondisclosure clauses. Definitions may be embedded in the operative clause. Select text, not a legal role-equivalence conclusion or an invented list. Use unknown if no relevant defining text can be located.

source_obligations.statement: Recognize a Representatives exception only for recipient classes expressly permitted by the operative clause and preserve its confidentiality, need-to-know, and purpose qualifications.

origin.quote: (a) Subject to the restrictions set forth below in this Section 4, each Party may disclose the other Party’s Confidential Information to its directors, officers, employees, legal advisors, financial advisors and accountants, each bound by obligations of confidentiality consistent with this Agreement, who have a bona fide need to know (“Representatives”), but only to the extent necessary to carry out the Business Purpose.

source_provenance.quote: (a) Subject to the restrictions set forth below in this Section 4, each Party may disclose the other Party’s Confidential Information to its directors, officers, employees, legal advisors, financial advisors and accountants, each bound by obligations of confidentiality consistent with this Agreement, who have a bona fide need to know (“Representatives”), but only to the extent necessary to carry out the Business Purpose.

The Receiving Party shall not disclose, allow access to, transmit or transfer the Confidential Information to any third party without the Disclosing Party’s prior written consent, provided however that the Receiving Party may disclose the Confidential Information to those of its directors, officers and employees ("Representatives") who have a need to know the Confidential Information for the Purpose provided that the Receiving Party shall ensure that such Representatives treat the Confidential Information as confidential and at all times in a manner consistent with this Agreement and the Receiving Party shall be liable for any loss or damage resulting from any Representative failing to do so.

source_obligations.statement: Treat an employee-disclosure query as permitted only when the operative clause expressly includes employees within a qualified disclosure permission; a general third-party prohibition alone does not manufacture that employee-specific conclusion.
